basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Sheffield International Postgraduate Taught Merit Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Sheffield (Global Engagement & Student Recruitment)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Sheffield (Western Bank Campus, Sheffield)
degree_levels: Master of Science (MSc / MA / MEng / LLM)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Eligible full-time postgraduate taught master's programmes across all Sheffield faculties, including Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Biotechnology, and Materials Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~75 competitive postgraduate taught merit scholarships (50% full tuition fee waivers worth up to GBP 15,000+ each) awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally to international fee-paying students; typically 6 to 12 Pakistani master's candidates secure awards each cycle
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 12 months (1-year standard full-time taught master's degree)

nationality_requirements: International fee-paying students from all countries worldwide including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction under University of Sheffield regulations.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16-year BS / BSc / BE) from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 or 78%+ equivalent to UK First Class / 2:1 Honours).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; competitive merit scholarship recipients typically hold CGPA >= 3.70 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Must hold an offer (conditional or unconditional) to study an eligible full-time master's course at Sheffield starting in autumn 2027.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate year graduating prior to September 2027.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Internships, software projects, leadership roles, or community initiatives strengthen scholarship application responses.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each section) or TOEFL iBT minimum 88 (minimum 19 listening, 20 reading, 22 speaking, 19 writing). MOI certificates are not accepted.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Merit-based competition assessing academic excellence, leadership potential, and scholarship essay responses.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with another full UK government scholarship (e.g. Chevening).

tuition_fee.details: 50% full tuition fee waiver (worth up to GBP 15,000+), combined with departmental bursaries to provide comprehensive tuition relief.
tuition_fee.amount: 50% to 100% Tuition Waiver (up to GBP 27,000 value)

admission_application_fee.details: Applying for postgraduate taught programmes at Sheffield is completely free via the postgraduate online portal.

accommodation.details: Subsidized student village housing at Ranmoor / Endcliffe residences prioritized for international scholarship holders.

monthly_stipend.details: GBP 1,200 / month living stipend (~PKR 445,000 / month) provided through combined university living bursaries and departmental assistantships.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Sheffield is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: UK Student Visa fee (~GBP 490) and Immigration Health Surcharge (~GBP 776/year) covered by candidate.
visa_fee.amount: UK Visa & IHS fees borne by candidate

health_insurance.details: Full access to the UK National Health Service (NHS) throughout the master's degree programme.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized student dining across Sheffield Students' Union (voted #1 in the UK for over a decade) and self-catering residence kitchens.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital access to University of Sheffield Information Commons and Western Bank Library.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Master thesis laboratory facilities, Diamond engineering building access, and high-performance computing clusters.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized Sheffield Supertram and Stagecoach student bus transit passes.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (University of Sheffield, Sheffield, South Yorkshire, UK).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World top 105 university (QS World University Rankings 2025); Russell Group institution; UK top 5 for engineering research.
available_majors: MSc in Computer Science (Negotiated Learning / Conversion)
MSc in Civil Engineering & Structural Mechanics
MSc in Biological and Bioprocess Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 1 year (12 months full-time taught master's degree)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree with CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00, IELTS 6.5+ (min 6.0 each) or TOEFL 88+, Sheffield admission offer letter, and completed International Merit Scholarship application.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must hold an offer (conditional or unconditional) for an eligible master's course before submitting the scholarship application before May 12.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Draft compelling scholarship answers detailing how Sheffield's academic excellence will empower you to deliver tangible economic or social impact in Pakistan.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Sheffield Postgraduate Application Portal & Merit Scholarship System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for an eligible master's course at Sheffield and receive your 9-digit student application number. Step 2: Access the International Merit Scholarship online form and submit the scholarship questions before May 12, 13:00 UK time.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Apply for an eligible full-time postgraduate taught master's degree at Sheffield via the online portal.
Step 2: Receive your Sheffield student application number once your course application is submitted.
Step 3: Access the International Postgraduate Taught Merit Scholarship application form on the Sheffield website.
Step 4: Answer the required scholarship essay prompts detailing academic achievements, leadership examples, and future vision.
Step 5: Submit the scholarship application before May 12, 13:00 UK time.
Step 6: Scholarship Selection Panel assesses and scores applications.
Step 7: Successful recipients notified by early June.
Step 8: Accept the scholarship within the specified deadline and initiate UK Student Visa application.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first hold a course offer, then submit the International Merit Scholarship application form.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted as part of the initial course application via referee upload link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Structured essay responses demonstrating why you chose Sheffield, personal and professional achievements, and how the scholarship will support your future ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated within the course application personal statement.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Professional CV detailing qualifications, tech projects, and leadership roles.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interview; decisions are based exclusively on academic record and the quality of the scholarship application essays.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 88+.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: GBP 0 (Free to apply for course and scholarship)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation for all official records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Sheffield International Merit Scholarship portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in relevant discipline (minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00).
Complete transcripts of undergraduate records showing all course marks and grades.
Proof of conditional or unconditional admission offer to an eligible Sheffield master's program.
Completed answers to the scholarship essay prompts detailing academic achievements, leadership, and future vision.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Craft compelling answers aligned with Sheffield's international community.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Professional CV detailing academic qualifications, technical projects, and extracurriculars.
Recommendation letters from university professors submitted with course application.
Official IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 88) test certificate.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Scholarship applications strictly close May 12, 13:00 UK time; applicants must hold a programme offer before applying.

selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 15% (Leadership track record and community initiative demonstrated in essays)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Technical capability, project background, and practical achievements)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 20% (Quality, articulation, and vision demonstrated in the scholarship application responses)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: University of Sheffield International Scholarships Committee and Faculty Representatives.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Scoring rubric assessing intellectual merit, future ambition, and capacity to act as a global ambassador.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,500 to 3,500 international applicants for Sheffield Merit Scholarships
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~75 competitive merit awards across postgraduate programmes
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4% to 6% among applicants holding strong GPAs and compelling essays
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates across STEM, engineering, and data science with solid academic records and dedicated social or community involvement.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, LUMS, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Malaysia, Kenya, Indonesia, Ghana, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official University of Sheffield portal https://www.sheffield.ac.uk/.
Never pay any fee to agents claiming to secure Sheffield scholarships.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for Sheffield postgraduate courses and merit scholarships is completely free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Sheffield explicitly states that scholarship essays must be the applicant's own work; agency-written generic essays are penalized.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Flight from Pakistan to Manchester/London: ~PKR 150,000 to 220,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can apply for the scholarship without a course offer. Reality: You must hold an active course offer to submit the scholarship application form.
Myth: Living in Sheffield is as expensive as London. Reality: Sheffield has one of the lowest costs of living among UK student cities.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sources claim late scholarship applications are considered; Sheffield strictly closes the portal at 13:00 UK time on May 12.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance throughout the master's programme.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time study attendance; scholars must agree to participate in international student promotional activities and ambassador events.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Term-by-term academic progress monitoring by the faculty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted up to 20 hours per week during term time under UK Student Visa rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Act as an International Student Ambassador during the year of study.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of award if student withdraws from programme or engages in disciplinary breach.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Subject change allowed only within eligible Sheffield postgraduate taught programmes with faculty approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the 1-year duration of the postgraduate taught master's programme.
